implement_exploration_module_subclass: implement a subclass of ExplorationModule that overrides act and compare methods for a custom strategy
use_exploration_type_enum: use the ExplorationType enum to select between UNIFORM, BOLTZMANN, REPRESENTATION, EPISTEMICNN, or VALUE strategies
call_act_method: call the act method on an ExplorationModule subclass to select an action from a subjective state and action space
call_reset_method: call the reset method on an ExplorationModule to clear its internal state before a new episode
call_compare_method: call the compare method on two ExplorationModule instances to get a string describing their differences
